title: Bare Bones x Tinkers' Construct
description: A Tinkers's Construct resourcepack in the style of Bare Bones
body:
An addon for RobotPants' Bare Bones (resource pack)

Requires mDiyo's Tinkers' Construct (mod)

**How to install:**
- Download the resource pack
- Go to %appdata%
- Copy .zip to /Roaming/.minecraft/resourcepacks
- Load Minecraft and select the Bare Bones Texture Pack

What is bare bones?
Bare Bones is a texture pack with the purpose of bringing your world and the default Minecraft textures to it's 'bare bones'. It is a simplistic and vibrant pack that is fun to use and makes your own Minecraft worlds look colourful!

This resource pack is under development.
